product.taglineZh: 从一篇短讯里拼出一句英语，带着宠物一起打卡。
product.taglineEn: Rebuild one sentence from a short dispatch — check in with your pet.

contentNote: Demo articles are original newspaper-style copy for the prototype. Production should use licensed feeds or partner content — do not scrape copyrighted papers verbatim.

articles.headline: City expands weekend bike lanes along the river
articles.headlineZh: 本市沿河增设周末自行车道
articles.dek: Officials say the pilot will run through spring before a wider rollout.
articles.dekZh: 官方表示试点将持续到春天，再决定是否扩大。

sentences.en: The city will open new bike lanes along the river this weekend.
sentences.zh: 本市将于本周末沿河开放新的自行车道。
sentences.noteZh: will open = 将要开放；along the river = 沿着河。

sentences.en: Local riders hope the pilot becomes a permanent route.
sentences.zh: 当地骑行者希望这次试点能变成永久路线。

sentences.en: Shops near the path expect more visitors on sunny days.
sentences.zh: 小路附近的店铺预计晴天会迎来更多访客。
sentences.noteZh: expect = 预计；on sunny days = 在晴天。

articles.headline: Central library tests late study hours for students
articles.headlineZh: 中心图书馆试行学生晚间自习开放
articles.dek: Quiet floors stay open until eleven on weeknights during exam season.
articles.dekZh: 考试季工作日晚间，安静楼层开放至十一点。

sentences.en: The central library will stay open until eleven on weeknights.
sentences.zh: 中心图书馆工作日晚上将开放到十一点。
sentences.noteZh: stay open = 保持开放；weeknights = 工作日夜晚。

sentences.en: Students can reserve quiet desks online before they arrive.
sentences.zh: 学生可以在到达前在线预约安静座位。
sentences.noteZh: reserve = 预约；before they arrive = 在他们到达之前。

sentences.en: Staff say the trial helps more people finish evening study plans.
sentences.zh: 工作人员表示，试行能帮助更多人完成晚间学习计划。
sentences.noteZh: trial = 试行；finish ... plans = 完成……计划。
